banner: Synthetic households only — the register below is fixture, never a real person. The machinery exercised — the export coordinate gate, the governed members, the digest — is the production code.

census.method: estate-wide grep for raw Feature/FeatureCollection construction outside the governed path — one site (households.to_geojson) found and adopted; apps JS and CSV writers carry no coordinates

governed_export.quantization: 5 decimal places (~1.1 m at the equator) — planning-map precision, stated

drills.attack: EPSG:3857 coordinates as degrees at the door
drills.name: a metre-space household is registered

result.detail: ValueError: invalid coordinates: lat=727867.6 lon=376170.8 — degrees are WGS-84 lat/lng; metre-space coordinates are not degrees, reproject first (geolock.transform)

drills.attack: collection() with a hand-built EPSG:3857 Point
drills.name: a caller-built feature smuggles a metre-space point past the layer helpers

result.detail: Error: coordinate out of range at feature 0: 376170.8,727867.6 — metre-space coordinates are not degrees; reproject first (geolock.transform)

drills.name: a geometry outside the closed vocabulary arrives

result.detail: Error: geometry type 'GeometryCollection' at feature 0 is outside the closed export vocabulary ('Point', 'MultiPoint', 'LineString', 'MultiLineString', 'Polygon', 'MultiPolygon') — an ungated geometry is an unstamped one

drills.name: a feature is tampered with after the stamp

result.detail: recomputed features digest c345085006fd… != stamped 1453d8c28c5d… — the checksum catches it

drills.name: an export runs with no registry injected

result.detail: basis is rfc-7946-default-stated and quantization is stated — the default is disclosed on the artifact, not assumed

drills.name: a caller requests an identified export

result.detail: the artifact carries anonymized: false ON ITS FACE — the privacy downgrade is data, never silence (household id HH-DEMO-00 present by explicit choice)

honesty.census_is_data: raw-GeoJSON sites: 1 before, 0 after — the seam is adopted by its own estate, or it is decoration
honesty.checksum_presumes_deserving_bytes: the gate validates every coordinate BEFORE the stamp — a governed-looking digest over a metre-space feature was the hole
honesty.closed_vocabulary: geometry types are a closed set; GeometryCollection is refused until a caller needs it — an ungated geometry is an unstamped one
honesty.defence_in_depth: registration refuses bad coordinates with the offender named (first wall); the export gate re-checks caller-built features (second wall)
honesty.privacy_as_data: anonymization and 5dp quantization are foreign members on the artifact — a planner holding the file knows exactly what they are holding
